item.title: St. Joseph's Health to test AI technology to detect heart problems earlier
item.description: St. Joseph's Health is set to become one of the first hospitals in the country to test new AI-powered EKG technology, which can help with early diagnosis of heart problems and measure heart function.

item.title: New measures to cut bridge strikes on Onondaga Lake Parkway
item.description: New York State officials have implemented new safety enhancements and stricter driving penalties to reduce vehicle strikes at the Onondaga Lake Parkway Bridge, including the installation of vehicle detection sensors and LED signs, as well as increased penalties for drivers who strike the bridge.

item.title: Missing dog from Kirkville found 3 months later by drone company
